newsitem.title: VATICAN: Vatican denounces Polish abortion bill.
newsitem.headline: Vatican denounces Polish abortion bill.

text.p: The Vatican denounced passage by the Polish parliament on Thursday of a bill liberalising abortion, saying Pope John Paul's homeland had "chosen the path of death".
The semi-official newspaper L'Osservatore Romano launched the attack in an article which noted previous appeals by the Polish-born Pope for the legislation not to be adopted.
"With the liberalisation of abortion...Poland has taken a decisive step forward towards the culture of death," it said.
The Pope has used the phrase "culture of death" in the past to criticise countries for allowing abortion and euthanasia.

Poland's lower house, the Sejm, on Thursday overthrew a Senate veto and passed the bill liberalising abortion, which ex-communist President Aleksander Kwasniewski has promised to sign promptly into law.

L'Osservatore Romano noted that the Pope had recently urged Poles to pray that the right to life from conception to death would be respected in Poland. "A nation that kills its own children is a nation without a future," the Pope had said.

Polish legislators had assumed a "very grave responsibility, setting themselves up as arbiters of the life of all those unwanted human beings who, thus, can now be supressed with the benefit of the law", the newspaper wrote.

Polish women will now be able to end pregnancies before the 12th week if they face financial or personal problems, after counselling and a period of reflection. The bill also calls for sex education in schools and cheaper contraception.

Under the existing anti-abortion law, passed in 1993 by a pro-Catholic government, terminations are permitted only if a pregnancy threatens a woman's life or health, results from incest or rape, or when the foetus is hopelessly damaged.
The Polish Church had organised a huge protest campaign against the bill, culminating in a silent march on parliament on Wednesday by more than 30,000 people.
"The reservations and the objections of the Senate and the Catholic community meant nothing," read the article, which was headlined "Poland chooses the path of death".
